==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{UserWindows}}</nowiki></code> into your user page. The default icon displayed is the [[:File:Windows10.svg|Windows 10 logo]]; include {{Para|current|1}} for the [[:File:Windows.svg|most recent logo]] instead.
